notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 Notes
notes.content:
[b]Scan Ability[/b]
The archer class now has an ability called 'Scan'. When used this ability will show the exact health value of an enemy when leave the mouse hovering over that enemies square for a second. As well as the health value, tags will appear letting you know the enemies strengths and weaknesses.


[b]All Enemy Names Changed[/b]
Enemy names have been changed so that they are a little more interesting.


[b]Bugs Fixes and Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the new shop map icon was not being removed when generating a new floor.
[*]Wandering Spirit (prev. Ghast) magic damage on haunt increased.
[*]Lowered Viper (prev. Snake) health, raised Viper damage.
[*]Raised Skeleton Ranger (prev. Skeleton Archer) damage, raised Skeleton Ranger gold drop.
[*]Wizard class is more likely to appear at lower levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 Notes
notes.content:
[b]Mini Map Improvements[/b]
The mini map now shows question mark icons pointing towards areas of interest for each floor. Once you are close enough to see what the point of interest is, it will also change on the map.

There are new map and mini map icons for character class unlocks, stairs, area exits, shops and shrines. 

[b]Keyboard Camera Controls[/b]
You can now manually control the camera with WASD and Arrow Keys. You can reset the camera with Backspace. If in battle, the camera will still switch to an enemy or player when it is the start of their turn.

[b]Bugs Fixes and Other Changes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Field Medicine skill is now available to the warrior class from the beginning.
    [*]Field Medicine skill now has particle and sound effects.
    [*]Music for Exploration and Battle should now be at more appropriate volumes.
[*]Pressing the back button in class select now correctly takes you to the main menu.
[/list]
